description: A squat masonry box on the corner with no shopfront at all, which on this street makes it look like it is sulking. Five stone steps up to a pair of doors under a plain lintel, and cut into the lintel, in letters somebody was paid properly for: FINE PRINT · LENDING LIBRARY · SUBSCRIBERS AND CASUALS. The windows start above head height and tell you nothing. What tells you something is the roof: a long glazed lantern runs the whole length of the building, and at night it is the only thing in the Filaments throwing light UPWARDS.
name: Fine Print
